findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Arbitrary file access
 * @description File operations without proper path validation can lead to unauthorized file access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/arbitrary-file-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-073
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["read_text", "read_bytes", "write_text", "write_bytes", "open"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rmdir"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["join", "exists", "isfile"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may allow arbitrary file access if not properly validated."
findings.hypothesis: Check for arbitrary file read/write operations that could allow access to sensitive files

message.text: File operation that may allow arbitrary file access if not properly validated.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe URL parsing and handling
 * @description URL parsing operations that may not properly validate schemes or hosts
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-url-parsing
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 *        external/cwe/cwe-020
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("parse").getMember(["urlparse", "urlsplit", "urljoin"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "URL parsing or retrieval operation that should validate URL schemes and hosts to prevent SSRF."
findings.hypothesis: URL parsing vulnerabilities - improper validation of URLs that could lead to SSRF or other URL-based attacks

message.text: URL parsing or retrieval operation that should validate URL schemes and hosts to prevent SSRF.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unvalidated URL redirect
 * @description Following URLs without validation can lead to open redirect vulnerabilities
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unvalidated-url-redirect
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-601
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("parse").getMember(["urljoin", "urlunsplit", "urlunparse"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "URL operation that may follow redirects or construct URLs without validation."
findings.hypothesis: Unvalidated URL redirects that could be exploited for phishing or open redirect attacks
